scope: Discord frontend and Discord worker addon only
changes: Discord Player Post button reduced to compact DC label for PC and iPhone slots.
Added second compact MSG button for custom Discord channel messages.
MSG opens English overlay with access code input and message textarea.
Wrong code still triggers pink blinking ACCESS DENIED overlay.
Manual player post and custom message posts now include current metadata fields where available: Now Playing, listeners, bitrate, DJ/status, source, artwork thumbnail.
Automatic now-playing posting enabled only after a successful access-code unlock in the current browser session, preventing public visitors from spamming Discord.
Added gated /api/discord/message route and gate protection for /api/discord/nowplaying.
notes: Auto now-playing cannot run as a server-side background job in this package because no KV/R2/background scheduler was requested. It runs from the player only after the Discord gate code has been accepted in that browser session.
All visible Discord overlay text is English.
